verdict.rationale: CoreWeave docs show API Access Tokens for authenticating users/kubectl and granting resource access (coreweave-docs-8,17,26,35), plus group-based access control for AI Object Storage bucket policies (coreweave-docs-37) and token exchange for temporary storage credentials (coreweave-docs-38), which are pieces of scoped-credential management. However there is no evidence of a broader team-member/role management system (e.g., org-wide RBAC, named roles like admin/viewer) or of API keys being scoped to limit spend/budget controls tied to billing. Missing for 10: team member invite/role assignment UI or API, granular per-key permission scoping across all resources (not just storage), and spend-limiting controls tied to API keys.
